Name: Night Owl Interface
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28418/28418-1794276978-2030811957.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=4]This has been a long time coming. What was Galactic UI has been completely reworked from the ground up with increased compatibility, cleaner code, and a slightly different take. It now f[/size][size=4]eatures bigger tabs, bigger menus, and dark colors intended to be easy on the eyes without losing contrast.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]I'm no artist - so I'm 100% sure there's going to be stray pixels or mistakes here and there. If you spot any - let me know and I'll fix it up! On that same note, while I do play with 1300 mods, I'm sure there's some mod somewhere that's incompatible with this. Just let me know and I'll look into it.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]I do have compatibility for quite a few mods in the pipeline (waiting on permissions!) so as soon as I can get those I'll release the compatibility files. [/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28418/28418-1794276070-950308908.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=4]Download manually, open the archive, click and drag the folder in the archive into your mods folder.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Do not use Vortex.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]disclaimer:[/size][/center]
[center]AI helped me code - specifically the menu tab scaling and a run-through for bugfixes I didn't catch on my own.[/center]
[center][/center]

Manifest.Name: Night Owl Interface
Manifest.Description: A dark, starry interface for Stardew Valley 1.6: purple frames, charcoal panels, light text and a wider game menu with tabs that fit full 16x16 icons.
Manifest.Author: aerinanxiety
